integrity: Prior endpoint characterization and ordinary ell-infinity injectivity are acknowledged, not claimed as new. The new contribution is the exact unattained weak-star continuous projection infimum. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Real scalars, infinitely many equilateral points, and one explicit weak-star closed bad subspace. Ordinary projection uses noncanonical Hahn--Banach extension. Infinite weak-star nonattainment is analytical, not computational.
title: An unattained weak-star projection constant on nonattaining Lipschitz subspaces
